title: VPN client cannot connect
summary: User receives timeout while connecting to corporate VPN.
fix_steps: Restart VPN service, verify MFA prompt, and switch to fallback gateway.

title: Outlook keeps asking for password
summary: Repeated credential prompts in Outlook desktop app.
fix_steps: Clear cached credentials, re-open Outlook, and re-authenticate using SSO.

title: Laptop performance is very slow
summary: System lag and high CPU usage complaints.
fix_steps: Check Task Manager for heavy apps, run company endpoint health script, and reboot.
